## Changes

- Prevent stale settings and goal results from updating a panel after switching threads or closing it.
- Prevent plan implementation from interfering with a pending message submission.
- Keep thread-list refreshes from changing the panel layout.
- Group skills by their Codex-reported source and plugin, preserving full skill names.
- Ignore plan text and malformed responses when generating thread names.
- Align subpanel row spacing and corner radii with the Obsidian theme.
- Update compatibility for Codex CLI 0.160.0.
